what: Evidentiary-number manifest for the Research Note 'Chaos and Bifurcations in Continuous Language-Model Feedback'. Every number in the note is quoted from the full paper. Each entry gives the string as it appears in index.md (appears_as) and the phrase of the paper's LaTeX source that states it (paper_text, whitespace collapsed), with its line in that source at the stated commit.

generator.repository: [repository link to be added at publication]
generator.note: The research repository is private until the author releases it before journal submission. The paper is a working draft; recheck every entry against the released version before publishing the note.

verification: For each entry, (1) appears_as occurs in index.md after replacing en dashes, em dashes and minus signs with hyphens and removing asterisks, as scripts/check_provenance.py checks; (2) paper_text occurs in paper/llm/main.tex at the stated commit after collapsing runs of whitespace to single spaces.

batch-difference-schematic.svg.note: Hand-drawn conceptual schematic; no data, not to scale. Its description quotes the paper's 1.27 to 176% range and its 0 to 16 steps after the distance passes 1e-2.

one-picture-schematic.svg.note: Hand-drawn conceptual schematic of the paper's section 'From greedy loops to chaos: one picture'; not to scale, bar widths illustrative. Its labels quote the paper's values for that section: flip at log10 T = -0.5147881 and fold at -0.1741065 of the 2-cycle at alpha = 0.070, the band's flips at -0.1414292 and -0.1392937, windows of period 2N + 6 crowding as 1/N^2, and the period-3 fold at alpha = 0.065, log10 T = -0.14536.

Table 1.check: Transcribed from the paper's table; every loop and copy line (14 steps before the first difference to 9 after it) was reproduced from the records' most probable tokens, with line breaks shown as ↵ and the end-of-turn token as [end].
